alarm.question: What must entrants do when a gas alarm sounds in a confined space?
alarm.text: If any gas alarm sounds, all entrants shall leave the space immediately.

permit.question: How long is a work permit valid?
permit.text: A permit is valid for a maximum of 12 hours and shall not extend beyond the end of the shift in which it was issued.

retest.question: How often must the atmosphere in a confined space be re-tested?
retest.text: The atmosphere shall be re-tested at least every 2 hours while persons are inside the space.
